## Checklist

- [ ] Every value comes from the real repository, release or registry listing — nothing is guessed
- [ ] `remote` entries carry the SHA-256 of the file they point at
- [ ] Tags come from the list in the schema
- [ ] The dataset URL, if given, follows the latest release rather than a branch
- [ ] I maintain this configuration, or I have the maintainer's agreement to list it

Listing is a maintainer's decision, and an entry can be removed later. See
[List your configuration](https://datamitsu.com/docs/contributing/showcase).
